name: Comgrow (Shenzhen ZCSW Technology Co., Ltd.)
summary: Hong Kong-registered multi-brand 3D printing retailer founded in 2017, operating under the mainland entity Shenzhen ZCSW Technology Co., Ltd. Comgrow is an authorised Creality distributor that resells Creality filament (project-owner verified) and also sells own-brand COMGROW filament and accessories; it is a reseller/accessory brand rather than an independent extruder. A 2024 announcement indicates a merger with the related Sovol brand.

oem_relationships.notes: User-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md): Comgrow resells Creality filament and is not the manufacturer. Corroborated by Comgrow's own about-us page, which describes the company as an authorised distributor of Creality 3D printers.

Comgrow's about page describes Sovol as 'developed by their parent company', making the two sibling brands rather than supplier and customer. A 2024 company TikTok post announced a Comgrow/Sovol merger with Comgrow links redirecting to Sovol; independently unverified.
Reciprocal of creality.json edge; user-verified (research/verified-oem-relationships.md) — Comgrow resells Creality filament. Added in Phase E reciprocity pass.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: Own-branded Comgrow PLA, confirmed 2026-09-20 on comgrow.com/collections/filament, sold as a 6-pack of primary colours. This is genuinely Comgrow-branded stock rather than resold Creality/Sovol product.

product_lines.name: Hyper Filament PLA
product_lines.notes: High-flow/high-speed PLA formulation marketed '10x Faster Print, High Speed 30-600mm/s'. 'Hyper' is Creality's high-speed naming, consistent with the Creality rebrand relationship.

product_lines.name: Tri-Colors Silk PLA
product_lines.notes: Silk-additive PLA on a tri-colour spool (Gold, Green, Black), confirmed 2026-09-20 as own-branded Comgrow stock on comgrow.com, sold singly and as a 4-pack of 1 kg spools. Multi-colour is a spool feature, not a chemistry change. Listed under a PLA+ material label in aggregator data, but no toughened-PLA claim is made on the Comgrow listing itself, so the pla-silk mapping is kept.

product_lines.name: TPU 95A
product_lines.notes: Flexible TPU, Shore 95A stated on the listing.

additional_notes: Registered address RM 023, 9/F BLK G Kwai Shing Industrial Building Stage 2, 42-46 Tai Lin Pai Road, Kwai Chung, NT, Hong Kong; legal entity Shenzhen ZCSW Technology Co., Ltd. Sells PEI plates, double-sided build plates and flexible steel plates, though these appear to be largely Creality-branded rather than Comgrow-branded, so makes_plates=true reflects that it sells plates rather than that it produces them; no plate_ids are asserted. Also retails Creality (Ender, K-series) and Sovol printers and SH01-SH03 filament dryers (from $59). Manufacturing origin is China for both own-brand and resold Creality filament. Own-brand confirmation 2026-09-20: comgrow.com/collections/filament was reviewed and Comgrow does carry a small genuinely own-branded filament line alongside the Creality stock it resells — specifically a 6-pack of primary-colour PLA and a Tri-Color Silk PLA sold singly and in 4-packs. This refines rather than overturns the reseller-first characterisation: the own-brand range is thin, publishes no TDS, and sits beside a much larger catalog of resold Creality and Sovol product, but it is not nothing, and 'Comgrow only rebrands Creality' would be too strong a reading. Who extrudes the own-branded spools is still not established — Creality remains the obvious candidate given the verified reselling relationship and the shared 'Hyper' naming, but no source states it.

provenance.conflicts: Brand identity is unstable: a 2024 company TikTok announcement describes a Comgrow/Sovol merger with Comgrow redirecting to Sovol, which is independently unverified and may make this entry a historical rather than a live brand. Whether Comgrow-branded filament is also Creality-produced (as opposed to only the explicitly resold Creality filament) is not established, and the build plates it sells are Creality-branded. Own-brand scope, clarified 2026-09-20: a review of comgrow.com/collections/filament confirmed a small own-branded Comgrow line (6-pack primary-colour PLA, Tri-Color Silk PLA singly and in 4-packs) in addition to the resold Creality filament, so the entry's reseller-first framing is retained but qualified. What remains open is unchanged and is the more consequential question: whether those own-branded spools are themselves Creality-produced. No TDS exists for any own-branded line, so nothing in the specifications distinguishes them.
